checks.name: Admin queue-policy control saves a real manual requeue policy
Staff creates an unowned profile and issues a walk-in number entirely through web UI
Doctor calls, recalls, marks missed and requeues BACK through visible controls
Reopening IN_PROGRESS walk-in from visible queue action resumes the persisted visit
Web completion saves consultation and completes the walk-in queue entry without an appointment

note: After creating the visit, the first harness looked for diagnosis in the vital-sign tab. Continued through the visible resume action and diagnosis tab; no mocked responses or database state overrides.
